_comment: goby's own answer to its own sweep. Everything here is a measurement the detector makes
correctly, on a file where the measurement is not the problem — the list exists so a real
smell in the same file is still reported, while this one decision does not have to be
An entry here is not an ignore: the file is still measured and still counted, and this run
logs it as suppressed. When a `known` entry stops firing, the sweep says so, so this list

known.reason: a frozen corpus of diff cases, one object per case: it is data the tests read, not code anyone maintains. Splitting it makes a case harder to find, cut a change harder to review, and moves no logic.
